summary: HTTPStorageBackend, registered for CONST_STORAGE_PROVIDER_TYPE.HTTP, performs reads (GET/streamed GET), writes (PUT) and metadata (HEAD) through the package HttpRequestEngine, so retry, redirect, auth-strategy and per-request location checks apply. It implements StorageReadProtocol (HTTPReadMixin), StorageWriteProtocol (HTTPWriteMixin), StorageMetadataProtocol (HTTPMetadataMixin) and, structurally via HTTPReadMixin.open_ranged, RangedReadProtocol; it does not implement Enumerate, Delete, Copy or Directory. Engine and httpx errors are translated to StorageError subclasses with credential-redacted paths.
key_classes: HTTPStorageBackend — registered HTTP/HTTPS backend; builds an HttpRequestEngine from connection.client, auth_strategy, policy and location_check, or uses an injected engine
HTTPReadMixin — StorageReadProtocol: read_to_bytes (GET), read_to_stream (forward-only streamed GET), plus open_ranged (RangedReadProtocol)
HTTPWriteMixin — StorageWriteProtocol: write_from_bytes / write_from_stream via PUT; create_parents ignored
HTTPMetadataMixin — StorageMetadataProtocol: path_exists, get_metadata, get_size via HEAD
key_functions: HTTPReadMixin.open_ranged(path) -> RangedSource — probes 'Range: bytes=0-0' with identity encoding; pins later ranges with If-Match on a strong ETag; 416 with 'bytes */0' yields an empty source

_helpers._map_error(exc, path) -> StorageError | None — maps 404/401/403/412 and transport errors to PathNotFound/Authentication/PermissionDenied/ObjectChanged/StorageConnection/StorageError; leaves request-construction errors native
_helpers._mapped(path) — context manager raising the mapped error from a credential-safe cause
http_metadata._size(headers, path) — parses Content-Length; invalid values raise StorageError
extension_points: Inject a pre-built HttpRequestEngine (engine=) to control client, policy and auth; combining engine= with location_check= raises ValueError.
Pass a custom RequestPolicy (policy=) and AuthStrategy (auth_strategy=); this is the only built-in backend that accepts auth_strategy (registry guards others).
Mixins are exported and can be recomposed into a custom backend that provides _get_engine().
lifecycle_notes: Stateless over a borrowed connection: the backend never closes the connection; StorageFacade owns and closes it.
HttpRequestEngine and httpx are imported inside functions so the module imports on a base install; using it needs the [http] extra.
read_to_stream returns a forward-only BufferedReader that holds the streaming response open until the caller closes it; errors may surface during consumption.
Retry/OAuth refresh apply before a response is yielded; bodies are not replayed after consumption starts (docs/read-access-modes.md).
documentation_hooks: Support matrix row: HTTP = Read, Write, Metadata, RangedRead; not Enumerate, Delete, Copy, Directory.
Random access over HTTP: range probe, identity-encoding requirement, RangeNotSupportedError cases, ETag If-Match consistency.
Error translation table for HTTP status codes to StorageError subclasses, including credential redaction.
HTTP write semantics: PUT only, create_parents ignored, caller stream errors preserved.
examples: examples/capability_checks/example.py — HTTP facade refuses list_dir with UnsupportedOperationError and reports read/write/metadata support
examples/http_engine/README.md — HttpRequestEngine retries and typed errors that underlie this backend
risks: HTTPStorageBackend docstring lists only Read/Write/Metadata; RangedReadProtocol support is structural (open_ranged on HTTPReadMixin, no explicit subclass), so docs derived from docstrings will understate capability.
Without a connection or engine, construction succeeds but every operation raises StorageConnectionError from _get_engine().
location_check is typed Callable[[str], None] in the backend and registry, while StorageFacade passes its _check method that returns str; the return value is ignored here.
get_metadata/get_size issue HEAD; servers that reject HEAD or omit Content-Length yield errors or size None.

evidence.detail: HTTPReadMixin(StorageReadProtocol) defines read_to_bytes, read_to_stream and open_ranged (RangedReadProtocol shape).
HTTP expected Read/Write/Metadata and excluded from Enumerate/Delete/Copy/Directory.
Ranged conformance cases cover http, s3 and sftp backends.
Describes HTTP bytes=0-0 probe, identity encoding and If-Match behaviour.
